t64bm1m.name: T-64BM1M
t64bm1m.authority: Release 262's true T-64 (owner 2026-10-27, "add these new tanks using our rigoorous tank generation workflow"): a published-dimension build, accepted on that route by Main on 2026-10-28; on 2026-10-31 Main deregistered the print it had been measured against (the build does not follow it) and ruled it onto this photographic route. The T-64B1 with Nizh, the 6TD-1 and the KT-12.7: the 2013-2014 Kharkiv order for the DR Congo, its first batch diverted to Ukraine's National Guard in 2014.
t64bm1m.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope of the true T-64 build (profiles/t64Foundation.ts, variant bm1m: Nizh over the glacis, the turret and the side screens; Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule): 3.612 m wide over its reactive armour, 9.405 m long (src/vehicles/t64Armor.ts T64_SILHOUETTE_DIMS.silhouetteOverallLengthM, the full lit length with the rear stowage), the tallest the whips (3.658 m; the body's p95 height is 2.788 m, T64_SILHOUETTE_DIMS.silhouetteHeightM). The hull follows the published T-64 figures (6.54 m hull, 3.27 m over the tracks, 2.17 m turret roof; docs/references/tanks/t64bm1m.md), not a print.
